chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadani from Mu'ttab from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) or he said from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)

He said: One day he said, 'O Mu'ttab! Seek out fresh fish for us, for I intend to get cupping done.' So I sought it out, then came to him with it, so he said to me, 'O Mu'ttab! Cook part of it in vinegar for us, and grill part of it for us.' So he had lunch from it, and Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) had dinner.
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam eat before cupping according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the practical wisdom of the Imams, specifically Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who utilized fresh fish as a dietary aid to facilitate cupping therapy (hijama), a common medical practice of the era. The specific preparation—preserving half and grilling the other half—demonstrates an early example of food preservation techniques and the Sunnah of utilizing available resources efficiently for health and sustenance.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ali Al Hamdany, from Ma’tab, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, or said, from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>

having said one day: ‘O Ma’tab! Seek out fresh fish for us<sup>asws</sup>, for I<sup>asws</sup> intend get cupping done’. So we sought it out, then came with it to him<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Ma’tab! Cook part of it in vingar for us, and grill part of it for us. So we had lunch from it, and Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> had dinner’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadaniy from Mu‘attib who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, or abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhim al-Salam,

once said, ‘O Mu‘attib, order for us fresh fish; I want to apply cupping.’ I ordered fish and brought them. He (the Imam) said to me to cook for him (the Imam) a part of it and roast another part. He (the Imam) had lunch with it and abu al-Hassan had dinner with it.’” Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from (his father) and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar from his father and Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah all from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadaniy has narrated a similar Hadith.”
